product_metadata.title: mDesign Metal Bathroom Over Shower Door Towel Rack Holder - Storage Organizer Bar for Hanging Washcloths, Bath, Hand, Face & Fingertip Towels - Bronze
features: STYLISH STORAGE: Over the shower door towel organizers keep hand towels, body towels and face towels always within reach; The open design makes grabbing a towel quick and easy when your hands are wet; Perfect for the bedroom, bathroom, small spaces and stall showers where space is limited; The vintage-inspired stylish design adds a decorative touch to any bathroom decor

MAXIMIZE SPACE: Make the most of unused space on the back of interior bathroom doors and shower stalls; Position where it's most convenient for your bathroom space; Use just one, or use multiples to create more storage just where you need it; Great for bathrooms, kitchens, closets, laundry or utility rooms, craft rooms and garages; Hang bath towels, microfiber dusting cloths, cleaning cloths and more; Perfect for small spaces; Try in apartments, condos, college dorm rooms, campers and RVs

EASY INSTALLATION: Easily installs by hanging over bathroom or shower doors for instant storage; Attach the over the door hook to the part, and the item is ready to hang; No assembly or hardware needed; Use in bathrooms, powder rooms and more; Holds many towel sizes
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of strong steel with a durable rust-resistant finish; Stainless steel finials; Easy Care - Wipe clean with damp cloth; DESIGNED IN USA
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 6" x 17.9" x 8.4" high; Fits over shower and interior doors up to 2" / 5cm thick
